description: A small fridge cabinet is in front on a countertop next to a microwave/oven, and inside are a burger on an upper shelf and fruit on a lower shelf. The left hand stays resting on the counter while the right hand reaches up to the fridge door, pulls it open toward the viewer, then reaches inside to grab and lift out the banana and then the burger, placing them down on the countertop in front of the open fridge before pushing the door back toward closed.
